components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Amber, ink-outlined button with a hard shadow that presses down.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary">ถัดไป: เลือกช่าง</button>
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 22px; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #111111); border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; font: 600 16px/1.3 'Prompt', 'IBM Plex Sans Thai', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #111111; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.12s, box-shadow 0.12s, background-color 0.12s; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffb22e; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #ffb22e; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #111111; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #111111; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 #111111; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 10px 22px; border: 2px solid #111111; border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; font: 600 16px/1.3 'Prompt', sans-serif; color: #111111; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.12s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f4f1ea; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffb22e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Tall outlined field with an amber focus ring.
components.css: .ds-label { display: grid; gap: 6px; max-width: 360px; } .ds-label span { font: 600 15px/1.4 'Prompt', sans-serif; color: #111111; } .ds-input { width: 100%; min-height: 56px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 2px solid #111111; border-radius: 16px; background: #fff; font: 400 17px 'IBM Plex Sans Thai', sans-serif; color: #111111; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9c9688; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #ffb22e; }

components.name: Time Slots
components.description: Chakra Petch time tiles: open, selected, taken.
components.css: .ds-slots { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 96px); gap: 10px; } .ds-slot { min-height: 56px; border: 2px solid #111111; border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; font: 600 19px/1 'Chakra Petch', 'Prompt', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: #111111; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.1s, box-shadow 0.1s; } .ds-slot:hover:not(:disabled):not([aria-pressed='true']) { background: #f4f1ea; } .ds-slot:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffb22e; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-slot[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #ffb22e; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #111111; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-slot:disabled { border: 2px dashed #c4bdae; background: #f4f1ea; color: #a39d90; text-decoration: line-through; font-weight: 500; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Status Chips
components.description: Dot-led outlined pills for booking status.
components.html: จองแล้ว เสร็จแล้ว ยกเลิก
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid #111111; font: 600 13px/1.5 'Prompt', sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip::before { content: ''; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-booked { background: #ffe2a6; color: #7a4b00; border-color: #c98a1a; } .ds-done { background: #cdebd7; color: #1d7a45; border-color: #1d7a45; } .ds-cancelled { background: #fbd9d3; color: #d93a2b; border-color: #d93a2b; }

components.name: Service Choice Card
components.description: Selectable service/barber card that lifts with a hard shadow.
components.css: .ds-svc { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 4px; width: 300px; min-height: 92px; padding: 16px 18px; border: 2px solid #111111; border-radius: 24px; background: #f4f1ea; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.12s, box-shadow 0.12s, background-color 0.12s; } .ds-svc:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 5px 0 #111111; } .ds-svc:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffb22e; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-svc[aria-pressed='true'] { background: #ffb22e; box-shadow: 0 5px 0 #111111; } .ds-svc-name { font: 600 17px 'Prompt', sans-serif; color: #111111; } .ds-svc-meta { font: 600 14px 'Chakra Petch', monospace; color: #2a2a2a; }

components.name: Top Navigation
components.description: Sticky cream bar with ink-filled current link.
components.html: จองคิวคิวของฉันหลังร้าน
components.css: .ds-top { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; min-height: 72px; padding: 0 16px; background: rgb(244 241 234 / 0.92); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); border-bottom: 2px solid #111111; } .ds-top a { padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 12px; border: 2px solid transparent; font: 500 16px/1.4 'Prompt', sans-serif; color: #111111; text-decoration: none; } .ds-top a:hover { background: #e9e4d8; } .ds-top a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ffb22e; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-top a[aria-current='page'] { background: #111111; color: #f4f1ea; } .ds-top .ds-admin { margin-left: 8px; border-color: #111111; }

narrative.overview:
A bold, high-contrast barbershop counter: near-black ink, warm off-white paper, and one barber-pole amber. Everything is a chunky physical object: 2px black outlines, big rounded corners, and hard offset shadows with no blur, so cards and buttons look like printed tickets and cardboard tokens you can press. The booking ends in a literal paper ticket with a perforation, a barcode and a status stamp.

The customer flow is a five-step stepper with large touch targets (48-56px) and a sticky dark summary card; the admin is a dark-sidebar dashboard with a timeline board per barber. Numbers, times and booking codes are set in Chakra Petch, a squared techno face, so they read like a queue display.

Motion is small and tactile: hover lifts 1-2px, press sinks 3px and the hard shadow collapses; the barber pole logo animates its stripes.
keyCharacteristics: Clipper black (#111111) outlines and text, towel cream (#f4f1ea) page, pole amber (#ffb22e) for selection and the main action.
Hard offset shadows (`0 5px 0` ink) instead of soft blur.
2px borders on every interactive card, input and button.
Chakra Petch for every time, code and count.

rules.name: The One Pole Rule
rules.body: Amber marks exactly what is selected or what to press next. If two things on a screen are amber, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Ink Outline Rule
rules.body: Interactive surfaces carry a 2px Clipper Black border; disabled ones lose it to a lighter or dashed line.

rules.name: The Display Board Rule
rules.body: Any time, date number, booking code or count is Chakra Petch. Thai words never are.

rules.name: The Press-Down Rule
rules.body: Hover rises 1-2px with the offset; active sinks 3px and the shadow goes to `0 0 0`. Never use a blurred drop shadow on a card.

dos: Do outline every interactive card, input and button in 2px Clipper Black (#111111).
Do use hard offset shadows (`0 5px 0` / `0 3px 0` ink) and the press-down interaction.
Do reserve Pole Amber (#ffb22e) for the selected item and the next action.
Do set times, dates, codes and counts in Chakra Petch with tabular numerals.
Do keep touch targets at 48px or more (inputs and slots 56px).
donts: Don't use blurred drop shadows on content cards.
Don't add a second accent hue; red and green are status only.
Don't set Thai words in Chakra Petch.
